title: Lantern shrine
desc: Three shrine builds whose glow climbs in order as a player charges the lantern; J picked "a lantern shrine or base (charging altar or tower, glow reacting to the charge)".

takes.name: Charging altar
takes.facts: 3-step dais, altar lantern; lantern > step runes bottom to top > braziers (0.85) > beam (0.95); charge 0 > 1 over ticks 20-140, overcharge 1.3 at 150 held to 190, fades by 250; each lit part lights over 0.25 of charge after its threshold

takes.name: Lantern tower
takes.facts: 8-block tower, BR1 windows floor by floor (0.08-0.93) > crown (0.9) > beam; charge 0 > 1 over ticks 20-140, overcharge 1.3 at 150 held to 190, fades by 250; each lit part lights over 0.25 of charge after its threshold

takes.name: Pillar ring
takes.facts: 8 pillars, W1 seams, r 4; pillar by pillar (0.1-0.85) > arcs over the tops (0.97) > beam; charge 0 > 1 over ticks 20-140, overcharge 1.3 at 150 held to 190, fades by 250; each lit part lights over 0.25 of charge after its threshold
